title: Successive-stride roughness does not establish incremental cross-dataset Parkinson discrimination
abstract: Successive-stride roughness was tested beyond age, sex, speed, mean stride and CV. Models fitted in31 gaitndd participants were frozen and evaluated in157 gaitpdb participants. AUC changed0.71459 to0.71492, paired target95% difference interval−0.00296 to+0.00412. Source/target refit intervals included no gain for both AUC and log loss. Sensitivity checks revealed substantial demographic/protocol/detector shift. This is a scoped negative incremental-prediction result, not a validated biomarker. Different archives were tested, but participant overlap cannot be ruled out. Public hashes, reproducible offline code, preserved correction and author checks are supplied.
